in_hindi.name: हरिक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: विष्वक्सेन के साथ रहने वाला हरिक्षा, यह विष्वक्सेन के नाम से उत्पन्न हुवा है, विष्वक्सेन ईश्वर का नाम है

in_tamil.name: ஹரிக்ஷா

in_telugu.name: హరిక్షా
in_telugu.long_meaning: హిమదేశ్య సహజేయదేశదేశ హరిక్షా, ఆ హరిక్షా హిమదేశ్య ఇయేశ్వరియ ఇ름ే ఉత్పత్తిటే ఉత్పాదేశ్యదేశయోగదేశ్యదేశ ఆశ్రైయపైఠో

in_marathi.name: Hariksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Hari's auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hariksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hariksha is a beautiful and unique name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words, 'Har' and 'Ksha'. Har represents the name of the God Vishnu, who is also known as Hari. Ksha means auspiciousness or prosperity. Thus, Hariksha can be interpreted as the embodiment of God Hari's blessings and good fortune.
